name: week
title: The week
subtitle: Physio Clinic for Claude Code: the diary and what wants a decision, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Booked, next 7 days
sections.note: Every visit on the diary. UNCONFIRMED rows are tomorrow's DNAs unless someone calls.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, substr(starts_at::text, 1, 5) as at, practitioner, patient, service, coalesce(case_ref, '') as case, case when status = 'booked' then 'UNCONFIRMED' else status end as state from v_appointments where on_date between current_date and current_date + 7 and status in ('booked', 'confirmed') order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: Classes, next 7 days
sections.note: Booked of capacity. A full class with people waiting is a second class asking to be scheduled.
sections.sql: select ref, to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, substr(starts_at::text, 1, 5) as at, service as class, practitioner, booked || ' of ' || capacity as booked, case when spaces <= 0 then 'FULL' else spaces || ' spaces' end as state from v_classes where status = 'scheduled' and on_date between current_date and current_date + 7 order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: Clinical records not finalised
sections.note: A completed visit without a finalised note. Worst first.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon') as visit, days_since || ' days ago' as age, patient, practitioner, service, note_state, ref from v_notes_due order by on_date

sections.title: Funded cases running down
sections.note: ACC claims and care plans with two or fewer sessions in hand. Start the next approval before the last session, not after.
sections.sql: select ref, patient, title, funding, sessions_used || ' + ' || sessions_booked || ' of ' || approved_sessions as committed, sessions_remaining as remaining from v_cases where status = 'open' and approved_sessions is not null and sessions_remaining <= 2 order by sessions_remaining

sections.title: Recalls due inside 7 days
sections.sql: select to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon') as due, patient, phone, reason from v_recalls where due_on <= current_date + 7 order by due_on

name: clinical
title: The clinical record
subtitle: Notes, consent and funded care, straight off the tables

sections.title: Open cases
sections.sql: select ref, patient, title, funding || coalesce(' ' || claim_number, '') as funding, case when approved_sessions is null then sessions_used::text else sessions_used || ' of ' || approved_sessions end as sessions, case when consent_recorded_on is null then 'NOT RECORDED' else to_char(consent_recorded_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') end as consent from v_cases where status = 'open' order by opened_on desc

sections.title: Treatment plans
sections.note: Sessions done against the agreed cadence, and the outcome score against the goal. Nothing booked on an unfinished plan is a patient dropping out.
sections.sql: select ref, patient, measure, baseline || ' to ' || coalesce(latest_score::text, '?') || ' (goal ' || target || ')' as score, coalesce(progress_pct || '%', '') as progress, sessions_done || ' of ' || planned_sessions as sessions, greatest(0, sessions_expected - sessions_done) as behind, coalesce(to_char(next_booked_on, 'DD Mon'), 'NOTHING BOOKED') as next from v_plans where status = 'active' order by next_booked_on nulls first, patient

sections.title: Consent missing on treated cases
sections.note: Right 7, Code of Health and Disability Services Consumers' Rights 1996. Nothing completes on these until consent is recorded.
sections.sql: select ref, patient, title, sessions_used as visits from v_cases where status = 'open' and consent_recorded_on is null and sessions_used > 0

sections.title: DNAs, last 180 days
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon') as date, patient, practitioner, service, dnas_180 || ' in 180d' as habit from v_dnas order by on_date desc

name: money
title: The money
subtitle: Who owes what, patients and funders separately

sections.title: Patients owing
sections.sql: select ref, patient, to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon') as due, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, case when days_overdue > 0 then days_overdue || ' days overdue' else 'not yet due' end as state from v_invoices where payer = 'patient' and status = 'sent' and balance_cents > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Claims by state
sections.note: Ready claims are money in a drawer; blocked ones wait on a note; lodged ones past three weeks are a query.
sections.sql: select funder, status, count(*) as claims, round(sum(amount_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount, max(coalesce(days_lodged, days_since_service)) || ' days' as oldest, sum(case when status = 'ready' and note_status <> 'final' then 1 else 0 end) as blocked_by_note from v_claims where status not in ('paid', 'written_off') group by funder, status order by funder, status

sections.title: Funder invoices unpaid
sections.sql: select ref, payer, patient, coalesce(case_ref, '') as case, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, days_overdue || ' days overdue' as state from v_invoices where payer in ('acc', 'medicare', 'dva', 'insurer') and status = 'sent' and balance_cents > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Takings by practitioner, last 14 days
sections.sql: select practitioner, sum(visits) as visits, round(sum(takings_cents) / 100.0, 2) as takings from v_takings where on_date > current_date - 14 and on_date <= current_date group by practitioner order by takings desc
